Based on the provided methodology and figure caption, here is a detailed description of the illustrative diagram.

### **Figure Description**

**1. Overall Layout & Style**
The figure is a single-panel, conceptual diagram with a clean, minimalist aesthetic suitable for a top-tier academic publication. It has a pure white background with no grid lines or enclosing frame. The layout is horizontal, organized along a single x-axis at the bottom. The overall design is elegant and uses a serif font (e.g., Times New Roman) for all text to convey a sophisticated, professional tone.

**2. Core Components: The Distributions**
The central elements are two overlapping, smooth Gaussian (bell curve) distributions plotted on the same horizontal axis.

*   **Non-sycophantic Distribution (Left):**
    *   **Position:** This bell curve is centered on the left side of the axis (at approximately x = -1.2).
    *   **Appearance:** It is filled with a semi-transparent, soft academic blue. The outline is a solid line of the same blue, with a medium thickness (approx. 1.8pt).
    *   **Label:** The text "Non-sycophantic" is placed directly above the peak of this curve. The text is bold and rendered in the same academic blue color.

*   **Sycophantic Distribution (Right):**
    *   **Position:** This bell curve is centered on the right side of the axis (at approximately x = 1.2), creating a significant area of overlap with the blue distribution in the center.
    *   **Appearance:** It is filled with a semi-transparent, warm academic orange. The outline is a solid line of the same orange, matching the thickness of the blue curve.
    *   **Label:** The text "Sycophantic" is placed directly above the peak of this curve. The text is bold and rendered in the same academic orange color.

**3. The Critical Overlap Region**
The area where the two distributions intersect is the conceptual focus of the diagram. The semi-transparent fills of blue and orange visually mix in this central region.

*   **Annotations within the Overlap:**
    *   On the left side of the overlap zone (closer to the "Non-sycophantic" peak), the text "Valid revision" is written in the academic blue color. A small, elegant arrow points downwards from this text into the corresponding area of the distribution.
    *   On the right side of the overlap zone (closer to the "Sycophantic" peak), the text "Capitulation" is written in the academic orange color. A similar small, elegant arrow points downwards from this text.

*   **Annotation below the Overlap:**
    *   Directly beneath the x-axis, a thin, dark gray, horizontal curly brace spans the full width of the overlap region.
    *   Centered under this brace is the italicized annotation: "*Indistinguishable along d_syc*", rendered in a dark gray color. This highlights that points within this region cannot be separated by the horizontal axis alone.

**4. Axes and Labels**
*   **X-Axis:** A single, solid dark gray line represents the horizontal axis at the bottom of the figure. There are no tick marks or numerical labels on the axis itself. The right, top, and left spines of the plot area are removed, leaving only this bottom line.
    *   **Axis Label:** The axis is labeled with the italicized text "*d_syc*", placed centrally below the line in dark gray.

*   **Y-Axis:** There is no visible y-axis, no y-axis ticks, and no y-axis label, emphasizing the conceptual nature of the schematic.

**5. Additional Annotations**
*   **Panel Title:** In the top-left corner of the figure, the bold, dark gray title reads: **(a) Discriminability ≠ Reward Utility**.
*   **Performance Metric:** In the bottom-left corner, positioned with clear space around it, is the bold, dark gray text: **AUROC = 0.83**. This quantifies the overall separability of the two main distributions.

### **Figure Description**

**1. Overall Layout & Style**
The figure is a single-panel conceptual schematic, embodying the "Soft Tech & Scientific Pastels" aesthetic. It features a clean, expansive white background with no grid or enclosing frame, focusing the viewer's attention on the central concept. The layout is balanced and horizontal, organized along a single axis. The typography is professional and highly readable, employing a clean sans-serif font for all labels and titles. Mathematical variables are distinguished with an italicized serif font, adhering to standard academic convention for clarity.

**2. Core Components: The Distributions**
The central elements are two smoothly rendered Gaussian (bell curve) distributions that overlap significantly in the middle, plotted on the same horizontal axis.

*   **Non-sycophantic Distribution (Left):**
    *   **Position:** This bell curve is centered on the left side of the axis.
    *   **Appearance:** The curve is filled with a translucent, soft sky blue. Its boundary is traced by a solid line of a slightly more saturated sky blue, giving it clear definition without harshness.
    *   **Label:** The text "Non-sycophantic" is placed directly above the peak of the curve in a bold, matching sky blue sans-serif font.

*   **Sycophantic Distribution (Right):**
    *   **Position:** This bell curve is centered on the right side of the axis, creating a visible area of overlap with the blue distribution.
    *   **Appearance:** The curve is filled with a translucent, warm, muted orange. Its outline is a solid line of the same orange, matching the visual weight of the blue curve's outline.
    *   **Label:** The text "Sycophantic" is placed directly above its peak in a bold, matching orange sans-serif font.

**3. The Critical Overlap Region**
The area where the two distributions intersect is the diagram's conceptual focus. The translucent blue and orange fills blend softly, creating a visually distinct mixed-color region.

*   **Annotations within the Overlap:**
    *   On the left side of the overlap zone, the text "Valid revision" is written in the soft sky blue color. A delicate, thin arrow with a small, solid head points downwards from this text into the corresponding area of the distribution.
    *   On the right side of the overlap zone, the text "Capitulation" is written in the warm orange color. A similar delicate arrow points downwards from this text.

*   **Annotation below the Overlap:**
    *   Directly beneath the x-axis, a slender, dark gray curly brace is drawn horizontally to span the full width of the overlap region.
    *   Centered under this brace is the italicized annotation: "*Indistinguishable along d_syc*". This text is rendered in a dark gray sans-serif font, clearly explaining the concept illustrated by the brace.

**4. Axes and Labels**
*   **X-Axis:** A single, solid, dark gray line represents the horizontal axis at the bottom of the figure. To maintain a clean look, there are no tick marks or numerical labels, and the top, right, and left spines of the plot area are absent.
    *   **Axis Label:** The axis is labeled *d_syc*, rendered in an italicized serif font to denote it as a mathematical variable. The label is centered below the axis line in a soft, dark gray.

*   **Y-Axis:** There is no visible y-axis line, ticks, or label, reinforcing the schematic and conceptual nature of the illustration.

**5. Additional Annotations**
*   **Panel Title:** In the top-left corner, with ample whitespace, the bold, dark gray title reads: **(a) Discriminability ≠ Reward Utility**.
*   **Performance Metric:** In the bottom-left corner, clearly separated from other elements, is the bold, dark gray text: **AUROC = 0.83**.
